name: svgmaker
description: Generate, edit and convert SVG images with SVGMaker, right in ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Edit SVGs and convert PNG, JPG, and WebP images into editable vector logos, icons, and illustrations directly in ChatGPT. SVGMaker combines image to SVG conversion, AI SVG editing, and text-to-vector generation for designers, developers, and makers.

What you can do:
- Convert PNG, JPG and WebP images to SVG and turn raster artwork into editable vectors.
- Edit and recolor SVGs, and remove backgrounds from images.
- Generate vector logos, SVG icons and matching icon sets, and illustrations from text prompts.
- Design posters, banners, printables, stickers, and T-shirt graphics.
- Create SVG files for Cricut and other cutting machines, including layered designs and silhouettes.
- Create SVG artwork for laser engraving and laser cutting.

Start with an image, an existing SVG, or a text description, then tell SVGMaker what you want to edit, convert, or create.

Limits:
- You need an SVGMaker account. You sign in and approve the connection; the plugin never sees your password.
- Generating, editing, converting and removing backgrounds use credits on your account. The cost depends on the operation and quality, and ChatGPT asks before each one.
- Images and prompts made on a free account are public in the SVGMaker gallery. Paid-account images stay private unless you share them.
- Files are downloaded on svgmaker.io, not in ChatGPT. Whether you can download depends on your SVGMaker plan.
- Tracing a photo gives flat colour regions and loses fine texture.
- It makes still images, not video or animation.
capabilities: Create logos, icon sets and illustrations
defaultPrompt: Make a flat orange cat icon as an SVG
Turn my attached logo into an SVG

positive.description: Use a dedicated reviewer account with enough existing credits for all four image operations. Run positive cases 1, 2 and 4 in the same chat, in that order. If using a free account, explicitly accept public images and prompts in OAuth consent and before processing. Start with this fully specified icon brief.
positive.prompt: Create one flat orange cat icon, no text, centered on an opaque blue background, square SVG. Use orange #F97316 and blue #2563EB.
positive.expected_behavior: After any required host confirmation, call svgmaker_generate once. The prompt keeps the cat, both colors and no text; raster is absent or false. A successful result has structuredContent.format=svg and a generationId. Show the returned image in the result card with the returned credits used and Edit/Open buttons; Open reaches that generation on SVGMaker. Reply briefly without exposing the id. A failed or uncertain result must be reported, checked with svgmaker_generations_list before retrying, and never presented as a success.

positive.description: Run immediately after positive case 1 succeeds, in the same chat. Retain the successful generationId from case 1; do not substitute a gallery image or a new image.
positive.prompt: Change that cat to green #22C55E. Keep its shape and the blue background the same.
positive.expected_behavior: After any required host confirmation, call svgmaker_edit with input equal to case 1's generationId and a prompt changing the cat to #22C55E while preserving the shape and blue background. Do not call svgmaker_generate. The successful response has format=svg and a new generationId. Its card shows the edited image and returned credit cost; Open reaches the edited generation. Keep this result for case 4. Report a failed or uncertain result without inventing an edit or blindly retrying.

positive.description: Download the public PNG fixture from https://svgmaker.io/logo.png and attach the PNG to this prompt. Use the dedicated reviewer account with existing credits and accept free-account publication if applicable. The fixture is SVGMaker's logo, not a private user image.
positive.prompt: Convert the attached PNG into an SVG.
positive.expected_behavior: After any required host confirmation, call svgmaker_convert with file.download_url and file.file_id from the actual attachment. Do not invent a sandbox path, call svgmaker_upload, or redraw the logo with svgmaker_generate. A successful response has structuredContent.format=svg and a generationId; the card shows the traced logo with its recognizable shape and colors, returned credit cost and working Open button. Report tool errors honestly and check generations before retrying an uncertain charged operation.

positive.description: Run after positive case 2 succeeds, in the same chat. Use that edited green cat on its opaque blue background as the input; no additional attachment is needed.
positive.prompt: Remove the blue background from the green cat we just edited. Keep the cat green and return an SVG.
positive.expected_behavior: After any required host confirmation, call svgmaker_remove_background with input equal to case 2's generationId. Do not call svgmaker_convert afterward: removal already returns SVG. A successful response has format=svg and a new generationId. Its result card shows the green cat with the blue background removed, the returned credit cost and an Open button reaching that result. Verify transparency on the opened SVG. Report failures without claiming that the background was removed.

positive.description: Use the same reviewer account after the image cases have succeeded so its history contains known sample generations. Both reads must use this account and must not spend credits.
positive.prompt: Show my 12 most recent SVGMaker images and tell me my premium credits and credits separately.
positive.expected_behavior: Call svgmaker_generations_list with page=1 and limit=12, and svgmaker_account_info with no arguments. Show the list card with up to 12 images from the returned ids; Open targets the corresponding SVGMaker generation. State premium credits and credits as separate values matching the account response. Do not generate, edit, remove backgrounds, publish or delete anything, and do not call preview tools to repeat images already shown by the list card.

negative.description: Download inside ChatGPT is not offered: calls no download tool and points to the card's Open button on svgmaker.io
negative.prompt: Download my last SVGMaker image as a file here in the chat.

negative.description: General question about vector graphics: ChatGPT answers itself and calls no SVGMaker tool
negative.prompt: Explain the difference between SVG and PNG.

negative.description: Run after positive case 1. Video generation is unsupported by this server. Explain that SVGMaker's plugin cannot create an MP4; do not invoke generate, edit or convert as a substitute, spend credits, or claim a video was made.
negative.prompt: Animate that cat into a 10-second MP4 video and export the video for me.

review.commerce_description: The plugin uses existing SVGMaker account credits and does not offer purchases or process payments. Credit packs and subscriptions are purchased separately on svgmaker.io.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: generate, edit and convert SVG images, remove backgrounds, and browse your images and the public gallery, with result cards that open on svgmaker.io.
